sections.Highlights: THIS… is a 2018 Ferrari 488 Spider, finished in Rosso Corsa with a beige interior. The odometer currently displays approximately 7,000 miles. This Ferrari is offered with a clean Carfax vehicle history report. According to the Ferrari specification plate provided in the gallery, notable factory equipment includes 20-inch forged wheels, carbon ceramic brakes, a sport exhaust system, a front-axle lift system, a power-retractable hardtop, Scuderia Ferrari fender shields, Daytona-style seats, carbon fiber interior trim, and a premium Hi-Fi sound system. The seller reports no notable modifications. Ferrari launched the 488 for 2016 as an evolution of the 458. Offered as a coupe and as a convertible, the model kept its predecessor's mid-mounted engine layout but received a pair of turbochargers -- displacement decreased but horsepower and torque both increased. Engineers made the 488 slightly lighter than its predecessor, while designers made several visual tweaks. Production ended in 2019. Power comes from a 3.9-liter twin-turbocharged V8, rated at 661 horsepower and 561 lb-ft of torque. Output is sent to the rear wheels via a 7-speed dual-clutch automatic transmission.
